title: Presiding Member of National Commission in Absence of President

content.scenario: The President of the National Commission is on leave, and there is a retired Judge of the High Court who is a member of the National Commission. Who will preside over the National Commission?
content.outcome: The retired Judge of the High Court, being a member of the National Commission, shall preside over the National Commission in the absence of the President.

user_queries: Who presides over the National Commission when the President is absent?
What happens when a retired Judge is a member of the National Commission?
